results.question_text: Reference Drawing: Tanforan R20 JT 4.0 There is tree in direct contact with the proposed service trench to 31 Tanforan. The property owner does not wish to remove the tree. To facilitate keeping the tree, the trench will have to be offset approximately 5’ to the west or east. Option A. If offset to the east, we will have to use two 45’s to bring it to the riser location. This will exceed the max allowed 315 degrees. This would also result in longer cable run for PG&E. Option B. If we offset to the west, we can use 1 45 and a total of 315 degrees. However, this option would put the trench into the 29 Tanforan property. Please advise us on how to proceed. Please also confirm the correct amount to offset the trench from the center of the tree.

root_cause_clarity.root_cause: Insufficient initial design of signage that did not meet fire department standards.

summary.one_line: This RFI emphasizes the importance of adhering to AHJ requirements for signage to avoid compliance issues.

results.question_text: Per AHJ (South San Francisco Fire Department) direction, the signage design in submittal 4832 Revision 2 is not sufficient for building signoff. The size, color, and location are all required to be revised. The Fire Inspector reviewed temporary signage at the original location in multiple colors and sizes (white, black, 21" text, etc), and all were deemed inadequate. While the overhang was lit above the signage, it provided too much of a shadow on the sign for it to be adequately legible. As directed by fire department, the permanent sign is to be moved to the terracotta section to the East of the main lobby entry. Elevation can remain approximately the same (~13' to bottom of sign). Signage is to be revised to white and is to be doubled in size (28" text). Building 1 pre-final is contingent on the requirements outlined above. Please review attached photo of approved temporary sign for further clarity on the requirements. 1. Please confirm it is acceptable to change design of sign to meet AHJ (SSFFD) requirements as shown in the attached photo. 2.Confirm that address should be centered at terra cotta joint for permanent installation.
